text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/resend_failed_sms.py (P1): it inserts the repo root into sys.path, imports delivery_status/sent_messages/queue_sms from notifications/sms.py, matches each 'failed' status ID back to its original SmsMessage, and re-queues the same text via queue_sms(m.household_id, m.template_id, m.params), skipping households that raise ValueError (opted out) or RuntimeError (SMS disabled). Delivered messages and messages with no status entry are never resent. Ran the script once (P2), appending one new SMS line per failed message to data/outbox/sms.jsonl with new IDs continuing the SMS-NNNNN sequence.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
